name: Helcim
line: US and Canadian payment processing with online checkout and invoicing.

free.text: No monthly, setup, minimum or cancellation fee

cells.payout: US 1–2 business days; Canada next day if eligible

fee.math: Helcim's extra margin (its own fee on top of the base card fee) for US and Canada online card payments, for up to $50,000 a month in volume. The base card fee, called interchange, varies by card.
